name: Litto
description: Social token launchpad on LighterEVM. Create, discover and trade community coins. Devnet available.
longDescription:
Litto is a social token launchpad on LighterEVM, built for people who want to create, discover and trade community coins in one place.

The app combines token creation, bonding-curve trading, charts, holder data and wallet positions. Trade-linked notes, profiles and following bring trader context into the market view. Coins that reach the graduation threshold move into Litto's own AMM.

A working LighterEVM devnet application is publicly available at https://dev-test.litto.fun. Visitors can browse markets and charts without connecting a wallet; on-chain actions use devnet assets. The pilot has completed a controlled acceptance run covering coin creation, curve trading, graduation, AMM trading and fee claims.

Production launch is still upcoming. The current integration uses LighterEVM devnet contracts, without routing trades through a Lighter Core or Robinhood integrator account.
